{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Mustafar}} {{Species |image=[[File:The_Natives_of_Mustafar.jpg]] |name=Mustafarian |designation=[[Sentience|Sentient]]''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' |class=[[Insectoid]] |subspecies=*[[Northern Mustafarian]] *[[Southern Mustafarian]] |races= |height=*2.3 [[meter]]s {{C|Northern}} *1.5 meters {{C|Southern}} |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor=*[[Color|Gray]][[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle 5|''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle'' 5]] *Pale[[Darth Vader (2017) 22|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 22]] |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor=Yellow |distinctions=Heat resistant{{Databank|mustafar|Mustafar}} |lifespan= |origin=[[Mustafar]] |habitat= |diet= |language=*[[Galactic Basic Standard]][[Darth Vader (2017) 21|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 21]] *[[Mustafarian (language)|Mustafarian]] }} {{Quote|''Savage brutes'', little more than a worthless ''rabble''…|Vaneé|}} '''Mustafarians''' were an [[insectoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[mining]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Mustafar]] of which there existed two distinct [[subspecies]]: the tall, thin [[Northern Mustafarian]]s, and the short, stocky [[Southern Mustafarian]]s. ==Biology and appearance== [[File:Criakan-TalesFromVadersCastle5.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Southern Mustafarian.]] An [[insectoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]], Mustafarians were noted to be hardy and well adapted to survive their [[homeworld]] of [[Mustafar]]'s extreme temperatures. Both [[subspecies]] had distinct roles in society as well as differing physical attributes, with [[Northern Mustafarian]]s being of a taller build and reaching heights of roughly 2.3 [[meter]]s, while the shorter and stronger [[Southern Mustafarian]]s often reached heights of 1.5 meters. Northerners had less resistance to high temperatures than their Southern brethren, whose tough skin could better resist heat.''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' Both forms of Mustafarians had [[blaster]]-resistant skin, but they still needed [[armor]] to protect themselves while working around [[Magma|lava]] as it was very dangerous.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' Some Mustafarian clan leaders were known to be able to manipulate lava using [[the Force]].[[Darth Vader (2017) 24|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 24]] ==Society and culture== Mustafarians lived in underground caves created by Mustafar's native [[lava flea]]s as they ate through the [[planet]]'s crust. Living mostly in underground buildings designed in the shape of [[kahel cave fungus]], most of their species only ventured to the surface in order to mine the valuable minerals from the lava flows, or for a coming-of-age ritual in which a young Mustafarian must saddle up on a lava flea and leap over a raging lava stream without any protective clothing. Northern Mustafarians often became guards and expert lava flea riders, while Southern Mustafarians handled all heavy labor, although they could too ride lava fleas.[[Darth Vader (2017) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 23]] Members of the Mustafarian species spoke an insectoid, buzzing language of the [[Mustafarian (language)|same name]].
[[File:Mustafarians_lava.png|thumb|250px|Mustafarians collecting lava to be refined.]]
Mustafarians often fashioned armor from the heat-resistant shells of lava fleas and wore [[breath mask]]s while working near lava, which made them appear mysterious and uniform to outsiders.''[[Dark Disciple]]'' Floating on heat-shielded craft, many Southern Mustafarians on the surface wore this protective armor in order to scoop lava into giant cauldrons attached to metal rods, which could be carried away by [[DLC-13 mining droid]]s. ==History== ===Republic era=== Although they evolved separate in underground caves on Mustafar, the Northern and Southern Mustafarians worked together to collect valuable minerals from their homeworld's [[Magma|lava]] flows and had a trade agreement with the [[Techno Union]]. As a result, some aligned themselves with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Several Mustafarians present with the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] on Mustafar at the end of the war were slaughtered by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during his [[Mission to Mustafar|mission to eliminate]] the Separatist Council,''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]'' which had gone into hiding on Mustafar.{{Film|III}} ===Defying the Empire=== {{Quote|Mustafar is our world. We have already lost so much. The lifefires barely burn. It is time to come together…and save what is left.|Kkkt decides to rally the Mustafarians against Fortress Vader|}} [[Standard year|Years]] later Vader returned to Mustafar aboard a [[Naboo Royal Starship]]. A Mustafarian chieftain [[Kkkt]] spotted the ship plummet towards the surface and later sent a scout party to check it out. Comprising of four Mustafarians—[[Bbbl]], [[Rrrn]], [[Sssp]], and one other—the party were [[Skirmish on Mustafar|attacked]] by Vader, who killed Bbbl and the other Mustafarian. He then used a haunted [[Sith]] [[Mask of Lord Momin|mask]] to possess Sssp and Rrrn retreated back to Kkkt to tell him about what he saw. [[File:KkktAttacksFortressVader-2017DarthVader23.png|thumb|left|280px|Kkkt leads an army of Mustafarians to attack the fortress.]] Shortly after, Vader and the Sith spirit possessing Sssp began building a structure to channel the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] energies from a [[Sith cave]]. When the structure failed to channel it right, it became wrecked, and the two Sith started again. The attempts also affected the rest of Mustafar, causing lava storms to erupt on the clans. Kkkt came in contact with the rest of the clans and they planned to destroy this structure before it destroyed their homes. Kkkt led this newly formed army to [[Battle of Fortress Vader|attack]] the newly built [[Fortress Vader|fortress]]. They outnumbered the [[Fortress Vader Imperial garrison|Imperial garrison]] ten to one, but Vader still slaughtered many of them. Kkkt and the other chiefs then used the Force to channel a lava flow and flood the battlefield. With the garrison wiped out, Vader retreated back to the fortress and Kkkt's remaining forces began trying to destroy it. Vader, however, channeled the Force through it and it obliterated the last of the Mustafarian army. Kkkt was not the last Mustafarian to attack the fortress, as [[Criakan]] led his own army to destroy it. As they entered, they overran the defending [[Volcanic environment stormtrooper|lava troopers]] and found Vader's [[aide]] [[Vaneé]]. Criakan threatened him, but Vaneé pointed out Vader standing behind the Mustafarians. Subsequently, Vader proceeded to kill the invaders. [[Priestess]] [[Sssl]] of [[Clan Rrrt]] also led an [[Attack on Fortress Vader|attack]] on the fortress, leading an army of [[plague]]-infected Mustafarians to infect troopers around the complex and break into it. Vader faced them and was bitten by one of the infected troopers. However, the bite had only been on his [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]]-arm and Vader used [[the Force]] to take control of the infected Mustafarians, making them destroy Sssl and themselves.[[Star Wars
